KXNBAH2HBENCHPTS (sibling, different ser.rules_primary: If San Antonio records more total bench points than New York in the full game of the New York vs San Antonio professional basketball game originally scheduled for Jun 13, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXNBAH2HBENCHPTS (sibling, different ser.rules_secondary:
If the game is cancelled or postponed more than two weeks, then all markets resolve to a fair market price.

If both teams record an equal number of total bench points, then all markets resolve to 50/50.
